mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_channel_notify_log(id, notify_type, pay_channel, channel_event_id, payment_order_id, refund_order_id, channel_out_trade_no, channel_out_refund_no, event_type, signature_valid, process_status, raw_notify_json, received_at, created_at) VALUES (#{notification.id}, #{notification.notifyType}, 'wechat_pay', #{notification.channelEventId}, #{notification.paymentOrderId}, #{notification.refundOrderId}, #{notification.channelOutTradeNo}, #{notification.channelOutRefundNo}, #{notification.eventType}, 1, 'received', #{notification.rawNotifyJson}, #{notification.receivedAt}, #{notification.createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id, notify_type, channel_event_id, payment_order_id, refund_order_id, channel_out_trade_no, channel_out_refund_no, event_type, process_status, raw_notify_json, received_at, processed_at, process_message, created_at FROM payment_channel_notify_log WHERE pay_channel='wechat_pay' AND channel_event_id=#{event}

SELECT id, notify_type, channel_event_id, payment_order_id, refund_order_id, channel_out_trade_no, channel_out_refund_no, event_type, process_status, raw_notify_json, received_at, processed_at, process_message, created_at FROM payment_channel_notify_log WHERE signature_valid=1 AND (process_status='received' OR process_status='failed' AND processed_at<=#{before}) ORDER BY received_at, id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_channel_notify_log SET process_status=#{status}, process_message=#{message}, processed_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND process_status IN ('received', 'failed')
